args.query:
INSERT INTO cohort_summary (cohort, cohort_size, example_comment)
SELECT 
    p.cohort,
    (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM participants p2 WHERE p2.cohort = p.cohort) AS cohort_size,
    (
        SELECT p2.contact_notes 
        FROM participants p2 
        WHERE p2.cohort = p.cohort 
        AND p2.contact_notes IS NOT NULL 
        ORDER BY p2.participant_id 
        LIMIT 1
    ) AS example_comment
FROM (
    SELECT DISTINCT cohort FROM participants
) p;
